name: Gouffre Chtonien
description: Éveillé des profondeurs de la croûte planétaire, Gouffre Chtonien est une force de la nature faite d'obsidienne et de magma refroidi. Son pas massive fait trembler le sol, annonçant l'éveil des anciens dieux de la terre.

subject.archetype: Chtonian Titan Oracle - Colossal subterranean war diviner with volcanic rock physiology, multiple blind eyes sensing dimensional weaknesses, magma circulatory system visible through cracked obsidian skin, humanoid silhouette merged with primordial geological essence

loadout.armor_outfit: Natural tectonic carapace composed of cooling basalt plates fused with obsidian edges, asymmetrical jagged formations creating natural spikes and blades, volcanic rock shoulders with ember veins, magma-filled fissures running across entire body with internal glow, raw stone horns erupting from skull
loadout.arsenal: Massive drilling claw arm forged from volcanic rock and cooled magma, capable of crushing stone and drilling through dimensions, secondary arm as massive blunt appendage, body itself weaponized with internal geothermal pressure, jets of magma expelled from body joints, suffocating volcanic dust emanating from carapace gaps

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist in explosive forward lunge, body coiled with seismic tension, one massive drilling claw raised high ready to strike, volcanic rock feet planted with tremendous pressure causing ground cracks beneath, massive form leaning into aggressive forward momentum, multiple eyes locked onto dimensional tear ahead
attitude.emotion: Primordial predatory focus emanating supernatural dread, ancient intelligence calculating enemy weaknesses through dimensional sight, volcanic rage simmering beneath cooled exterior, oppressive presence bending reality around massive form

palette_names.name: Magma Orange-Red
palette_names.role: Internal energy, cracks, and accent glow

palette_names.name: Dimensional Purple-Black
palette_names.role: Reality tear effects and otherworldly elements

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic volcanic_glow with internal_magma_lighting, dramatic_rim_light_from_dimensional_fissures, volumetric_ash_fog, OSL_magma_fissures
color_and_light.mood: Menacing, oppressive, cosmically dread-filled, primordial terror

scenography.setting: Torn dimensional battlefield with ground erupting in massive seismic fissures, enormous shadow tentacles erupting from below through cracked earth, sky showing impossible geometry and reality folds, ancient blazing runes carved into broken ground, reality thinning and tearing at dimensional edges, collapsed dimension fragments floating
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Thick oppressive volcanic_dust_fog, supernatural dread_mist, dimensional_tears_with_purple_energy, ancient_runes_glowing_with_fiery_orange, ground_splitting_with_magma_exposure, reality_fragmentation_effects, suffocating_ash_fall, seismic_tremors
